raw_responses.English:
This figure presents a bar chart illustrating the Perplexity and Sparsity Rate for two different network architectures: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the Sparsity Rate, ranging from 10% to 80%, and is labeled with percentages. The vertical axis, labeled “Perplexity,” ranges from approximately 1 to 9, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 1. The blue bar corresponds to the Per-Output architecture, reaching a maximum value of approximately 8.2 at a Sparsity Rate of 70%, while the orange bar represents the Per-Layer architecture, with a maximum value of approximately 6.8 at the same Sparsity Rate. The bars are sorted in ascending order of Sparsity Rate. The Perplexity values for the Per-Output architecture are approximately 6.2 at 10%, 7.1 at 20%, 7.8 at 30%, 8.1 at 40%, 8.2 at 50%, and 8.2 at 60%, while the Per-Layer architecture exhibits values of approximately 5.8 at 10%, 6.5 at 20%, 7.1 at 30%, 7.6 at 40%, 7.8 at 50%, and 7.9 at 60%. A horizontal dashed line is present at 50% Sparsity Rate.
